punchline: In The Alchemist, a shepherd sells his whole flock because of a dream he had twice, and gets robbed on his first day abroad.
thirty_sec: In Paulo Coelho's The Alchemist, Santiago is a shepherd in Andalusia. Twice he dreams of treasure hidden at the Egyptian pyramids. A gypsy woman tells him to go. An old man who turns out to be a king tells him about his Personal Legend and takes a tenth of his sheep as payment. Santiago sells the rest, sails to Tangier, and on his very first day there, loses all his money to a thief.
question: Is there an idea that keeps coming back to you, no matter how often you set it aside?
